title: Where the threads meet now
lede: What does a frontier model look like when every thread converges?
body: A 2026 frontier model is the sum of this route: a Transformer, pretrained on filtered web-scale data, aligned with preference optimisation, reasoning with reinforcement-learned chains of thought, reading long context and images, and calling tools as an agent. GPT-5's router made the reasoning depth automatic. Releases now arrive monthly.

Two things are new. Frontier models are increasingly released in tiers of access rather than simply published, and governments have become direct participants: the EU AI Act's obligations for general-purpose models applied from August 2026, and in June 2026 a US export-control directive briefly took a deployed model offline.
